paper.title_en: Entanglement island and Page curve for one-sided rotating Kerr black holes
paper.abstract_en: We investigate the information paradox for one-sided asymptotically flat rotating Kerr black holes formed through gravitational collapse using the island prescription. Near the horizon, the dynamics of a scalar field can be described by an effective two-dimensional theory, which provides the framework for our analysis. We study how rotation affects the location of the island boundary $\partial I$, the Page time, and the scrambling time, treating non-extremal and extremal Kerr black holes separately. For non-extremal black holes, the emergence of an island prevents the unbounded growth of Hawking radiation entropy at late times and restores the unitary Page curve. We further find that the island boundary depends on the location of the cutoff surface, in contrast to the behaviour found for eternal Kerr black holes. In the extremal case, the late-time entanglement entropy of Hawking radiation approaches the Bekenstein-Hawking entropy of the extremal black hole. Our results demonstrate the important role of black hole geometry in determining the behaviour of entanglement entropy and suggest that the island prescription provides a semiclassical resolution of the information paradox for one-sided rotating Kerr black holes.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 论文用岛补丁研究单侧渐近平直旋转Kerr黑洞的信息悖论，分别处理非极端与极端情形，讨论岛边界、Page时间与打乱时间，并恢复幺正Page曲线；主题属于黑洞热力学与信息悖论方向，理论深度与方法信号较强，摘要清晰，值得点击进一步阅读。
decision.title_zh: 单侧旋转Kerr黑洞的纠缠岛与Page曲线
decision.abstract_zh: 我们利用岛补丁（island prescription）研究通过引力坍缩形成的单侧渐近平直旋转Kerr黑洞的信息悖论。在视界附近，标量场的动力学可以由一个有效二维理论描述，这为我们的分析提供了框架。我们分别处理非极端与极端Kerr黑洞，研究旋转如何影响岛边界$\partial I$的位置、Page时间以及打乱时间。对于非极端黑洞，岛的出现阻止了霍金辐射熵在晚期无界增长，并恢复了幺正的Page曲线。我们进一步发现，岛边界依赖于截断面的位置，这与对永恒Kerr黑洞所发现的行为不同。在极端情形下，霍金辐射的晚期纠缠熵趋近于极端黑洞的Bekenstein-Hawking熵。我们的结果表明，黑洞几何在决定纠缠熵行为中起重要作用，并暗示岛补丁为单侧旋转Kerr黑洞的信息悖论提供了一种半经典解决方案。
